bootstrap.statement: Bootstrap from the published site at the baseline commit. Each legacy-observed source baseline is the English as it stood then: the point future English changes are measured from. It is not evidence that the translation was made from, or reviewed against, that English. Every locale is published-draft and every translation is unreviewed.
